newsitem.title: USA: Dow shakes off selloff to end higher.
newsitem.headline: Dow shakes off selloff to end higher.

text.p: Blue chip stocks, hit early Friday by an earnings warning from Intel Corp., climbed back from a deep selloff to end slightly higher.
Based on early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average gained 1.72 points to close at 7,331.90 after earlier plummeting as low as 7,241.76.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines five to three on moderate volume of536 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
